text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: spike in 5xx and gateway timeouts observed in ap-southeast1 region. Errors rose from ~3% -> ~45% over the last 4m. Affected endpoints: /v1/chat, /v1/embeddings. Dash: https://grafana.internal/dashboard/db/region-errors?orgId=1&var-region=ap-southeast1

PagerDuty: paging Gina SRE and Leo Oncall (backup). Escalation: urgent.

Gina SRE: oncall Gina here, joining. Initial hypothesis: regional network flapping to backing services causing retries and request pileup. Pulling metrics and kube events.

Hao Infra: noticing increased TCP retransmits between gateway nodes and storage-proxy-ap. Cloud provider shows degraded network in AZ-b. Opening provider ticket now.

Ivy Runtime: model-serving in ap-southeast1 shows many 502s and connection resets. Cache pressure looks high; KV cache eviction skyrocketed. Sample runtime log: `2026-03-15T11:02:12Z ERROR stream failed upstream reset id=xyz len=512 model=llama-13b`

Jules Support: customers experiencing timeouts, several chat sessions dropped. Two enterprise customers reported latency spikes on Dedicated. Created ticket #INC-7490 and notified account teams.

Gina SRE: immediate mitigations proposal: 1) shift traffic for new requests to eu-west1 as fallback (gradual), 2) reduce batch sizes in ap-southeast1 to reduce memory/KV pressure, 3) scale up s3-proxy-ap replicas if possible. Agree?

Kara Product: agree on reroute. Need a short customer-facing note ready once we confirm diversion. Keep messaging: "we are routing new traffic to an alternate region to restore availability."

Ivy Runtime: we can change traffic-router weights. Recommend 5% -> monitor -> 30% -> 100% cadence to avoid overload in eu-west1. Also enable fallback quantized model for heavy streaming to lower RAM use in ap-southeast1.

Gina SRE: executing reroute 5% now: `traffic-router set-weight --route default --from ap-southeast1 --to eu-west1 --percent 5`

Hao Infra: scaling s3-proxy-ap now: `kubectl scale deployment s3-proxy --replicas=6 -n infra-ap` and adding horizontal pod autoscaler override. Watching network errors during scale.

Gina SRE: checking kube events: several pods in gateway-ap namespace showing `ImagePullBackOff` and `OOMKilled` around 11:01 UTC. Might be unrelated noisy deploy?

Ivy Runtime: I see a concurrent canary deploy to gateway-ap around 10:59 UTC (deploy-bot). If that canary consumed unexpected memory, could explain some OOMs. Can we roll that back?

Hao Infra: rolling back recent gateway-ap canary to stable v2.3.1: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/gateway -n gateway-ap --to-revision=50`

Jules Support: posting internal note to affected customers and raising priority for Dedicated customers. Linked status page draft: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1782007890-draft

Gina SRE: monitor after 5% shift... metrics: error rate for requests routed to eu-west1 = 4%, ap-southeast1 still at 42% for traffic not yet diverted. Proceed to 30% now.

Ivy Runtime: pushed a runtime throttling config to limit in-flight streams per worker in ap-southeast1 and lowered batch sizes for /v1/embeddings to reduce RAM pressure. Config ID: `runtime-config/limit-stream-ap-2026-03-15`

Hao Infra: provider confirms intermittent L2/L3 path issues in AZ-b; they advise expected 2-3 hour window to stabilize, ticket #CLOUD-11455. We should avoid reversing until they confirm.

Gina SRE: increased reroute to 30%. Observing eu-west1 latency uptick but within SLO. Will monitor for 3m before 100%.

Kara Product: preparing brief external note: "We are experiencing elevated errors in ap-southeast1 due to a networking issue. New requests are being routed to eu-west1 to restore service. We will update with ETA once provider confirms network stability."

Jules Support: sent proactive email to impacted customers with suggested mitigation: set region hint to eu-west1 or retry fallback.

Ivy Runtime: hotfix rolled to runtime to add exponential backoff on s3 proxy retries and to increase connection pool size for s3-proxy-ap on canaries. Patch: `runtime/hotfix/connbackoff-0315`. Canary looks stable for 7m.

Gina SRE: proceeding to divert 100% of new traffic to eu-west1 for now. Executing `traffic-router set-weight --route default --from ap-southeast1 --to eu-west1 --percent 100`

Hao Infra: node replacement underway for gateway-ap; cordoned two nodes in AZ-b. New nodes provisioning.

Leo Oncall: taking over watch from Gina for the next 3 hours. Gina, please handoff current state and actions pending.

Gina SRE: handoff: 1) new requests routed to eu-west1 (100%), 2) rollback applied to gateway canary, 3) s3-proxy scaled and provider ticket open, 4) runtime hotfix on canaries to increase conn pool and backoff, 5) support comms sent. Please monitor: eu-west1 capacity, streaming session failures pinned to ap-southeast1, and provider updates. Handoff time: 11:12 UTC.

Leo Oncall: acknowledged. I'll keep watch and coordinate any reversal when provider confirms.

Kara Product: scheduling postmortem and customer summary. Requested mitigation list: better deploy gating across regions, region-aware canary policies, stronger s3-proxy HA.

Jules Support: updating tickets: most customers accepted reroute instructions; a few asked for estimated failover duration. I replied with provider ticket ref and said we are monitoring.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: UPDATE: aggregate 5xx reduced to baseline (~1.5%) after reroute. ap-southeast1 still showing degraded health for existing long-lived streams. Incident state: mitigated -> monitoring.

Leo Oncall: setting 6-hour watch and scheduling follow-up call in 24 hours for postmortem. Owner: Gina SRE + Hao Infra + Ivy Runtime.

Hao Infra: will attach provider trace and traces from our agents to ticket #CLOUD-11455. Action: add more replicas for s3-proxy and improve readiness checks to avoid routing to pods with transient network issues.

Ivy Runtime: opening PR to runtime repo to default to stronger backoff and lower batch sizes under network congestion: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/842.

Gina SRE: starting postmortem draft and will include timeline, customer impact, and remediation items.

Jules Support: marking support side closed for now; will reopen if new customer reports surface.

incident-bot: :pager: INCIDENT MITIGATED. thread_ts=1782007890 resolved_at=1782007950

Leo Oncall: great work team. Keep an eye on any regression and let's ensure the postmortem includes an action to implement region gating before deploys.

Gina SRE: agreed. Postmortem incoming.
